title: Philips Validation Disc regression coverage
symptom: The two Philips Validation Discs contain structured hardware, graphics, UCM, real-time-media, input, storage, and performance tests that are not yet represented in E-Di's regression matrix.
expected: Selected validation cases run reproducibly and their authored result screens, timing measurements, and device events are captured as evidence for device-level compatibility work.
revalidation_reason: Payload-free inventories were generated for both local discs. Disc 1's Philips Tests menu was manually reached, but no individual validation result has yet been classified against a specification or hardware baseline.

scenario.video_standard: Disc 1 PAL; Disc 2 player standard to be verified per test
scenario.dvc: Disc 1 not required; Disc 2 requirement must be verified rather than inferred from inventory classification
input_events: capture its result screen and bounded diagnostics

hypotheses.hardware_explanation: A Philips-authored validation case can provide a smaller and better-controlled device stimulus than a commercial title, but its result is meaningful only after the tested subsystem, expected output, player standard, and any required hardware are identified.
supporting_evidence: Disc 1 contains named bitmap conceal/draw/fade/scroll/text and performance programs, LUCM, pointer tests, NVRAM/alarm/signal tests, and 68070/OS-9 analyzers.
Disc 1's authored menu exposes Visual Examples, Video Representations, Base Case UCM Functions, and Performance categories.
Disc 2 contains authored DYUV, RL7, XA, slideshow, channel-selection, trigger, and EOR/EOF real-time records plus two audio tracks.
contradicting_evidence: No real-hardware result captures or authoritative expected-value tables have yet been associated with individual cases.
Some performance tests may encode assumptions about a particular player revision, so raw numeric differences are not automatically emulator defects.
Disc 2's broad inventory-level DVC flag is not supported by an identified MPEG sequence and must be verified in the authored menu.
hypotheses.falsifying_test: Choose one case with a specification-defined result, run it twice with bounded diagnostics, and compare its device-level output to the cited requirement. If the case cannot be mapped to a defined device contract, retain it as observational evidence rather than a pass/fail gate.
citations: Philips Validation Disc Europe Disc 1 payload-free inventory
Philips Validation Disc Japan Disc 2 payload-free inventory

manual_verification.notes: The user reached Disc 1's Philips Validation Suite submenu. Its top-level choices include Visual Examples, Video Representations, Base Case UCM Functions, and Performance.
